South Africa Secures Series Win Against Ireland

South Africa has clinched a series win against Ireland, with Simon Harmer playing a key role. Harmer achieved his first Test 10-wicket haul, finishing with figures of 10 for 120, including 6 wickets for 16 runs in the second innings. Kagiso Rabada also contributed to South Africa's victory.
